Fund balances (p6) recorded as fund balance (8,918,507 -> 13,635,377); ending cash = Cash and cash equivalents 12,275,377 and certificates of deposit 1,360,000 as ending investments (p4); beginning cash not printed (null). Other financing (p6 Total column): Bond proceeds 3,860,000 -> debt_proceeds; Premium on bond issuance 78,136 less Debt issuance costs 27,986 -> other_financing 50,150; transfers in/out 1,068,144 each as printed. Statement Intergovernmental 2,633,129 kept whole (includes ARPA fund 1,047,235); the ARPA fund detail line is federal grants. Balance sheet from the governmental funds statement Total column (p4), whose totals equal the Statement of Net Position (p1). Detail: budgetary comparison schedules for every fund (General pp7-11 by department and object, major special revenue funds pp12-16, each nonmajor fund pp19-27); the nonmajor combining schedule (pp17-18) is not recorded to avoid double counting (its function grouping was used for nonmajor operating expenses). Lines with zero actual (budget only) are omitted; a printed '-' budget is recorded as 0. Capital outlay labelled with a function only where a heading/fund name/combining column prints it (Inheritance Tax and COVID ARPA capital outlay stay plain). Statement Principal 240,000 + Interest 20,650 = Courthouse Bond Fund Debt Service 235,650 + County Building Fund Debt service 25,000.
